sql.sql:
SELECT c.concept_id, c.code, c.display, c.definition, c.active
        FROM concept c JOIN closure cl_f0 ON cl_f0.descendant_id = c.concept_id AND cl_f0.ancestor_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE code = @f0_anc_code AND cs_id = @f0_cs)
        WHERE c.cs_id = @cs AND 1=1
        ORDER BY c.code
